items.definition:
the start of a football game; the beginning of an event
The kickoff for the game is at 7 PM.

a milky fluid from rubber trees; a type of synthetic rubber
Many gloves are made from latex.

a type of small, brightly colored parrot
The lori perched on the branch, displaying its vibrant feathers.

a pairing of opponents or competitors
The boxing matchup between the two champions was highly anticipated.

a recurring dominant idea or feature
The recurring motif of light and darkness is central to the novel.

the quality of being open, honest, and direct
Her openness about her struggles helped others feel comfortable sharing theirs.

serious and immediate danger
The explorers faced great peril in the uncharted jungle.

a period of violent and uncontrollable behavior
The elephant went on a rampage through the village.

the action of being born again or undergoing a spiritual or moral revival
The city experienced a rebirth after years of decline.

a layer at the back of the eyeball containing cells sensitive to light
Light-sensitive cells in the retina convert images into electrical signals.

a short, repeated musical phrase; a variation on a theme
The guitarist played a catchy riff that got everyone dancing.

a fortified wine originally from southern Spain
She offered him a glass of sherry before dinner.

a synthetic polymer used in various products, often for its heat resistance and flexibility
Many baking molds are made from silicone.

the highest male adult singing voice or the general meaning or character of something
He sang the tenor part in the choir.

an abrupt or unexpected change, especially one that results in a more favorable situation
The company achieved a remarkable turnaround in its financial performance.

the organ in the lower body of a woman or female mammal where offspring are conceived and in which they gestate before birth
The baby develops inside the mother's uterus.

a small, fierce, solitary cat or a strike not sanctioned by a trade union
The wildcat is a shy and elusive animal.

a state of controlled, temporary loss of sensation or awareness that is induced for medical purposes
The patient was given local anesthesia before the procedure.

a long, accompanied song for a solo voice, typically one in an opera or oratorio
The soprano sang a beautiful aria from the opera.

intense brightness of light; exceptional talent or intelligence
The brilliance of the diamond caught everyone's eye.

a barrier or manned entrance, typically one where security checks are carried out
Soldiers stopped the car at the military checkpoint.

a compound of chlorine with another element or group
Sodium chloride is commonly known as table salt.

an important underlying principle or foundation
Honesty is the cornerstone of a good relationship.

the quality or state of being free from error; accuracy
The teacher emphasized the importance of correctness in grammar.

an ordained minister of an order ranking below that of priest
The deacon assisted the priest during the church service.

the profession or science of preventing and treating diseases and conditions of the teeth and gums
She decided to study dentistry at university.

an additional performance, especially by a musician, at the end of a concert, requested by the audience
The audience clapped loudly, demanding an encore from the band.

An organ that produces and secretes substances.
The thyroid gland is located in the neck.

Overwhelming distress or grief.
The news of his departure caused her immense heartbreak.

A robbery or a hold-up.
The movie was about a daring bank heist.

A home providing care for the sick or terminally ill.
She spent her final days comfortably in the hospice.

A whole number (not a fraction).
The number 5 is an integer, but 5.5 is not.

The act of frightening or overawing someone.
He used intimidation tactics to get what he wanted.

A large bottle for wine or spirits; a powerful handgun.
We celebrated with a magnum of champagne.

the state of being naked
The film contained some brief nudity.

a remote settlement or military position
The explorers established an outpost deep in the jungle.

the excess that spills or is forced out
The bucket couldn't hold the water, and there was an overflow.

an unbroken view of the whole region surrounding an observer
From the hilltop, we enjoyed a stunning panorama of the valley.

a person who writes plays
William Shakespeare is a famous playwright.

an introduction to a book
The author wrote a short preface to the novel.

return on investment
We need to calculate the ROI for this project.

an informal photograph taken quickly; a brief impression or summary
The article provides a snapshot of the current economic situation.

a coniferous tree with short, needle-like leaves
We decorated a spruce tree for Christmas.

the ability to sustain prolonged physical or mental effort
Running a marathon requires a lot of stamina.

a medicinal substance taken to give a feeling of vigor or well-being; a carbonated drink
He drank a gin and tonic.

Virtual Private Network
I use a VPN to protect my online privacy.

land consisting of marshes or swamps; saturated land
The protected wetland is home to many bird species.

an abbreviation formed from the initial letters of other words and pronounced as a word
NASA is an acronym for National Aeronautics and Space Administration.

the study of the movements and relative positions of celestial bodies interpreted as having an influence on human affairs and the natural world
She believes in astrology and checks her horoscope daily.

a two-wheeled handcart used to carry a load or an ancient burial mound
They found ancient artifacts inside the burial barrow.

the scientific study of plants
She decided to major in botany because of her love for plants.

a priest or religious leader
The cleric delivered a powerful sermon on Sunday.

a machine used to compress air or other gases
The air conditioner's compressor stopped working.

the highest degree awarded by a university
She is currently pursuing her doctorate in astrophysics.

a small, high-pitched flute
The soldier played a tune on his fife.

a member of a small independent group taking part in irregular fighting
The guerrilla fighters launched a surprise attack.

a mark or impression made by pressing something
The fossil left a clear imprint of the ancient leaf.

the state or period of being an infant; an early stage of development
The new technology is still in its infancy.

a person who owns land
The landowner decided to sell part of his estate.

a woman or girl of Latin American origin or descent
She is a proud Latina artist.

a circle of constant longitude passing through a given place on the earth's surface and the terrestrial poles
The prime meridian passes through Greenwich.

a minor wrongdoing
Shoplifting is often classified as a misdemeanor.

a person who carries out a harmful, illegal, or immoral act
The police are still searching for the perpetrator of the crime.

summary
The film's synopsis was very brief.
